notes.title: JET SET CORPS - Major Update 2025!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Major Update: Jet Set Corps – Enhanced Gameplay & New Features![/b][/h2][p]Prepare for the ultimate alien-fighting experience in [b]Jet Set Corps[/b] with our latest Major Update! We've listened to your feedback and made improvements to deliver a smoother, more dynamic, and immersive adventure. The battle to save Earth has never been better—whether you're flying solo or teaming up in co-op mode.
[/p][h3][b]What's New:[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Improved Dynamic Movement:[/b] Glide, jump, and jet around with more fluid controls for a smoother and more responsive experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Steam Deck Compatibility:[/b] Enjoy the game anywhere with seamless Steam Deck support. Experience the same thrill of the Jetpack Marine on the go![/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced Translations & Language Support:[/b] We've expanded language options to make sure players worldwide can join in the fight against the alien menace.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gameplay Tweaks & Fixes:[/b] Based on player feedback, we've fine-tuned levels, improved AI behavior, and resolved various bugs, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable playthrough.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Switch Between Windows Seamlessly:[/b] Effortlessly switch between game window and system with a more intuitive and smoother transition, including a refined mouse cursor behavior.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story Mode Outro:[/b] The adventure doesn't end with the last battle! Dive into a revamped outro that offers a satisfying and cinematic conclusion to your intergalactic journey.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]What’s Next:[/b][/p][p]We're committed to continuously improving [b]Jet Set Corps[/b] with more updates to come, ensuring the game is as exciting and polished as possible. Keep the feedback coming, and get ready to blast off into new adventures![/p][p][b]Join the Jet Set Corps today—Save Earth and the Galaxy![/b][/p]
